qualification.details: Technologist (Nuclear Medicine): B.Sc in Nuclear Medicine Technology from recognized university/institution. Or B.Sc in life sciences with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine [Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques (DMRIT)/Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology (DNMT)/Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology (DFIT)]. Technical Officer (Nuclear Medicine): M.Sc Nuclear medicine technology from recognized university/institution. Experience: 5 years of experience as Nuclear Medicine technologist (B.Sc Nuclear Medicine or equivalent + 5 years experience). Senior Technical Officer (Nuclear Medicine): M.Sc Nuclear Medicine Technology / from recognized university/institution with 60% marks. Or M.Sc with minimum 60% marks from a recognized university/institution with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine [Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques (DMRIT)/Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology (DNMT)/Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology (DFIT)] with minimum 50% marks. Experience: 4 years' experience.

selection_process: Short listing of candidates based on educational qualification and relevant experience Screening test in case of large number of applications Scrutiny of application and verification of documents Interview at AIIMS Nagpur
how_to_apply: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Nagpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026.
Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Nagpur to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download AIIMS Nagpur Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Technologist (Nuclear Medicine): B.Sc in Nuclear Medicine Technology from recognized university/institution. Or B.Sc in life sciences with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine [Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques (DMRIT)/Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology (DNMT)/Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology (DFIT)]. Technical Officer (Nuclear Medicine): M.Sc Nuclear medicine technology from recognized university/institution. Experience: 5 years of experience as Nuclear Medicine technologist (B.Sc Nuclear Medicine or equivalent + 5 years experience). Senior Technical Officer (Nuclear Medicine): M.Sc Nuclear Medicine Technology / from recognized university/institution with 60% marks. Or M.Sc with minimum 60% marks from a recognized university/institution with post graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine [Diploma in Medical Radio-Isotope Techniques (DMRIT)/Diploma in Nuclear Medicine Technology (DNMT)/Diploma in Fusion Imaging Technology (DFIT)] with minimum 50% marks. Experience: 4 years' experience.

content_sections.text: Short listing of candidates based on educational qualification and relevant experience Screening test in case of large number of applications Scrutiny of application and verification of documents Interview at AIIMS Nagpur

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the AIIMS Nagpur Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 12-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of AIIMS Nagpur to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Nagpur (AIIMS Nagpur) for healthcare positions in Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies available for Technologist, Technical Officer, and Senior Technical Officer posts in Nuclear Medicine.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form along with the required documents and fee receipt is 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General, OBC, and EWS candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 1,000/-, while SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are exempted.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for these posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the advertised posts under AIIMS Nagpur Recruitment 2026 is upto 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are needed for Technologist (Nuclear Medicine)?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.Sc in Nuclear Medicine Technology or B.Sc in life sciences with a post-graduate diploma in Nuclear Medicine from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Senior Technical Officer (Nuclear Medicine)?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Senior Technical Officer position will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 1,08,320/-.

faq.question: Q8. Is the job permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The positions offered under this advertisement (Advt No: AIIMS/NGP/RECT/CONT/26/10/2679) are strictly on a contractual basis.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application submission?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted online through the provided Google Form link after making the necessary online payment via NEFT.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for these posts?
faq.answer: Selection will be based on shortlisting according to qualifications/experience, a screening test if necessary, document verification, and a final interview.
